platforms.title: Instagram
platforms.intro: Reduce notification pull and set gentle daily boundaries without deleting the app.

steps.title: Turn off non-essential notifications
steps.body: Profile → ☰ → Settings → Notifications → disable Likes, Comments, Followers, Live videos.
steps.tip: Keep DMs on if you use them for real conversations.

steps.title: Enable Sleep Mode
steps.body: Profile → ☰ → How you use Instagram → Time management → Sleep Mode → set start/end time and days.
steps.warning: Sleep Mode mutes notifications but does not block app opening.

steps.title: Set a daily time reminder
steps.body: Profile → ☰ → Your Activity → set reminder below your current daily average.

platforms.title: TikTok
platforms.intro: Use Screen Time tools to interrupt automatic scrolling before it runs away with your evening.

steps.title: Enable Screen Time limit
steps.body: Profile → ☰ → Settings and privacy → Time and Wellbeing → Screen Time → set a daily limit. Start at 30–45 minutes.

steps.title: Turn on Screen Time Breaks
steps.body: Same menu → Screen Time Breaks → choose a 10, 20, or 30 minute interval.

steps.title: Disable engagement push alerts
steps.body: Settings and privacy → Notifications → turn off Likes, Comments, and New followers.

platforms.title: YouTube
platforms.intro: Break the autoplay loop and add gentle reminders that help you leave when you meant to.

steps.title: Turn off Autoplay
steps.body: Use the Home feed Autoplay toggle, and Settings → General → Autoplay next video.

steps.title: Set a Take a Break reminder
steps.body: Profile → Settings → Time watched → Reminders → every 30–60 minutes.

steps.title: Set a Bedtime reminder
steps.body: Same menu → Reminders → Bedtime → set a cutoff hour.

platforms.title: YouTube Shorts
platforms.intro: Shorts are a separate high-risk feed. Treat them with stricter limits than regular YouTube.

steps.title: Isolate Shorts usage
steps.body: Time watched → tap the Shorts tab in the usage chart before setting a limit.
steps.warning: Shorts autoplay loops continuously — the highest-risk feed for time loss.

steps.title: Remove Shorts shelf from home
steps.body: Settings → General → toggle off Shorts recommendations where available.

platforms.title: Facebook
platforms.intro: Quiet Mode and daily reminders create real friction — not just quieter notifications.

steps.title: Enable Quiet Mode
steps.body: ☰ → Settings & privacy → Settings → Your Time on Facebook → Manage Your Time → Quiet Mode → set a schedule.
steps.tip: This blocks reopening the app during set hours, not just notifications.

steps.title: Set Daily Time Reminder
steps.body: Same menu → Daily Time Reminder → set below your current daily average shown in See Time.
